cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Will you help me set up Denise's surprise leaving party at seven?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I spent the last one washing glasses.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'll wash up. Could you get Denise out of the office while I decorate?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She won't leave before I finish her spreadsheet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send it over. I'll finish her spreadsheet; could you take her for coffee and complain about how little I do?

mechanism: A recruits a colleague into a surprise-party diversion by granting exemptions and assigning even personal help from a superior position.
confusable: Generic helpful organizing would trade chores; this pair treats B practical questions as permissions A controls.
comparison: Office workload and a departing colleague differ from sibling credit and the birthday cake ceremony.
seedUse: Use D07-b washing and spreadsheet dependencies, merging them with S01 self-assigned supervisory privilege.
